title: Transportation Specialist I, ROC
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon ROC (Relay Operation Centre):
  

Join a team that offers best learning opportunities and work experience in transportation execution, supply chain and operations management. A place where you can start/restart/advance your career and progress to leadership roles at Amazon.
  

ROC (Relay Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. In addition to support provided for ATS organization This organization supports externalization of ROC capabilities to external shippers and vendors.
  

Along with this tactical problem\-solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
  

Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation network and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  

  

Location: Bangalore, KA IND  

  

Hours of Operation/Shift Timings: Rotational shifts (Position involves rotational shifts to support 24/7 operations. Schedule accommodations will be considered based on individual needs  

Medium of support: Multi\-mode (Voice and non\-voice)  

  

A synopsis of a ‘Transportation Specialist’ role:
  

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (  

Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Transportation Specialist at ROC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
  

* Inbound (IB) Operations deals with Vendor/Shipper/Carrier/Amazon Sites relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked\-up on time and is delivered at destination sites as per the given appointment.
* Outbound (OB) Operations deals with Amazon Sites/Carrier/Carrier Hub/Shipper destination sites relationship, ensuring that the outbound truck leaves Amazon sites/Shipper origin sites to deliver customer orders as per promise.
* Transportation Specialists addresses any potential issues such as appointment bookings, reschedules, in\-transit disruptions, weather impact situations etc. occurring during the lifecycle of pick\-up to delivery.
* In addition to the IB or OB operations, transportation specialists support variety of tasks such as load scheduling, load cancelations, supporting network capacity management, coordinating with non\-Amazon transportation organization such as rail, sea organizations, manage remote gate\-houses, managing equipment availability, equipment maintenance and such.

  

A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real\-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements from sites/carriers/shippers/drivers and be able to analyze data and effectively communicate the resolution or actions with an effort to meet the network speed and customer promise. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Transportation Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.  

  

Key job responsibilities

We are hiring high\-potential SEO Executives (Fresher) who wants to build a strong career in organic growth, search strategy, and content\-driven scaling.

title: Customer Support Manager, Compliance
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE**


Comfortable working in a hybrid office environment (3 days minimum) plus working US\-business hours (EST/PST time zones).

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

description:
Akanksha is on a mission to build one of the largest and most innovative networks of schools in India, serving children from low\-income communities, to maximize their potential. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

**Position: Computer Teacher**

**Function/Team:** Akanksha

**School Location:** Seawoods (Navi Mumbai)

**Compensation:** Based on skill sets, experience and sector standards

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary:**

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. You will work with grades 3\-10 to implement our digital skills and computer science curriculum.

**Overview of the Team:**

The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Establishing and maintaining a co\-operative working relationships with students, parents, community and the school team

● Clearly articulating high expectations for students

● Creating and maintaining an aesthetically positive environment

● Actively participating in network opportunities for professional development

● Attending and participating in all school training and meetings

● Meeting professional obligations through efficient work habits

● Actively participating in all extra\-curricular and celebratory activities in school

● Making occasional community visits to stay connected with parents

● Observe other team members to learn more about the school culture, classroom management, content and skill execution

● Working collaboratively with the Digital Learning Core Team at Akanksha

● Coordinating with the School/IT team to set up and manage the required device infrastructure at the school

● Supporting schools and teachers to integrate digital skills in other subjects.

**Experience**

● Candidates with prior education/certification/experience in computer science / IT can apply

● Past teaching experience is preferred but freshers also encouraged to apply

● BCS, MCS, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./MSc. in CS, B.Tech/MTech in CS are preferred.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** US Recruitment Admin Lead to oversee and manage the recruitment administration team. This role is critical in ensuring the smooth execution of recruitment operations, maintaining compliance, and driving process improvements across the hiring lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of US hiring practices. Recruitment Admin lead will be responsible for performing day to day task as per the recruitment process guidelines: 1\. Lead and mentor a team of recruitment administrators supporting US hiring operations. 2\.Oversee interview scheduling, offer management, background checks, and onboarding coordination. 3\. Ensure data accuracy and compliance within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Talent Acquisition \- End to End involves managing the entire recruitment process from start to finish. This includes identifying job needs, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and making job offers. The goal is to efficiently fill positions with the best talent. Responsibilities also include onboarding new hires and ensuring a smooth transition into the company. This role is crucial for building a strong and effective workforce. Assess current and future talent needs, identify mission\-critical workforces, understand key workforce skills and competencies, and address talent gaps.  

**What are we looking for?** Excellent communication skills, Uses professional, error\-free grammar and formatting in emails Speaks with clarity, warmth, and confidence during virtual interactions. Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR business partners to streamline administrative processes. Monitor and report on recruitment metrics and SLAs to ensure operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in recruitment workflows and documentation. Ensure adherence to US labor laws, EEO guidelines, and internal compliance standards. Manage vendor relationships related to background checks, job boards, and onboarding tools. Provide training and support to new team members and stakeholders on recruitment systems and processes.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of moderately complex problems • May create new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures • The person would require understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals • Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor • May interact with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture • Guidance would be provided when determining methods and procedures on new assignments • Decisions made by you will often impact the team in which they reside • Individual would manage small teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

description:
Posting Description:
**Job Title\-** IND Group Manager \- Business Service Support**ARL\-** 5\.1**Solution Line\-** Commercial Risk**Position type\-** Full Time
**Work Location\-** Bangalore, Whitefield**Working style\-** Hybrid**Cab Facility\-** Yes
**Shift Time \-**US Shift.
**People Manager role:** Yes**Required education and certifications critical for the role\-**Graduation or Post Graduation **Required years of experience –**15\-18 years of relevant US Insurance experience \& People Manager experience **AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

  

**INFORMATION ABOUT BUSINESS**  

Commercial risk team provides risk solutions to businesses across many sectors within the US. As part of an industry\-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting Risk Capital  

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**
You will be managing a team of 60 plus colleagues’ part of Aon’s US Commercial Risk Team.
The Business Service Manager is responsible for co\-ordinating and managing the provision of support to Team members based in US, drawing upon designated service teams and business support resources. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Manage the service provided to Colleagues based in US by your team of Business Service Support.
* Build effective working relationships with US and India based Team to ensure the best of Aon and the highest level of service is provided in line with the agreed service tools.
* Experience in team management, and ability to lead team of up to 60 or more BSS Colleagues, ensuring that their objectives are aligned with the overall business strategy, that performance is satisfactory, and any necessary action is taken to continually to develop capability of the team.
* Empowering team members with skills to improve their confidence, product knowledge, and communication skills.
* Adhere to all HR processes and dates.
* Experienced in implementing the adequate process controls and review mechanism.
* Collaborate and work with other support functions i.e., Quality, IT, HR, Admin etc for the operations stabilisation and delivery results.
* Coach and mentor direct reports where appropriate, to support personal and professional development of the team.
* Strong Stakeholder Management Skills including BI and MIS Reporting
* Managing SLAS and KPIs of Team and Leading Productivity and Lean Initiatives for the Team
* Strong Transition Management Skills
* Responsible for Team Engagement, Hiring, Performance and Retention Management

 **HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**


In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.


Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!


Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

description:
Overview:
* Ensuring support to manufacturing manager in meeting the production targets, SA along with optimum efficiencies.
* Co\-coordinating with manager in deciding the optimum capacity utilization across lines and SKU combinations for the shift based on the capacities and dispatch priorities \- communication the packaging leader of the plan and develop them working jointly to sustain key packaging deliverables in line with AOP.
* Ensuring minimal waste \+ rejects and maximum capacity utilization in shift.
* Ensuring smooth and efficient running of all lines and minimum downtime.
* Ensuring Zero debate BBS related best practices \& SOPs are followed by operators. No LTA/ fire incident in manufacturing.
* Why\-why analysis of all the process related issues and closing actions with Engineering within agreed timeline.
* Ensuring compliance of all the Key controls.
* Clearing AIB, safety, M\&W related audits with no NC in manufacturing.

title: AVP, Learning & Development (L10)
description:
Job Description
**Job ID**
2601024
**Category**
HR
**Date posted**
04/09/2026  

  

**Role Title** **: AVP, Learning \& Development (L10\)****Company Overview**: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by Ambition Box Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.

**Organizational Overview**:
This role will be part of the Synchrony Asia HR/L\&D team which is dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth within the company. We work closely with various functions and leadership teams to identify organizational leadership learning needs and provide targeted solutions that align with business goals. In a dynamic and collaborative environment, we prioritize data\-driven decisions, evaluating the effectiveness of our leadership programs to ensure we are meeting both employee and organizational needs. The L\&D team plays a key role in shaping the company’s workforce and helping employees unlock their full potential.**Role Summary/Purpose**
In this role, you will have responsibility for the design, management, delivery, and ongoing evaluation of learning programs that help our employees advance their skills and knowledge, while identifying growth gaps. You will support plans to bridge these gaps by serving as a consultant on programs and programming driven by the Learning \& Development team. You will support ongoing development in line with current organizational needs by partnering with stakeholders and HR partners across all hubs (U.S., India and Philippines), as well as anticipating future development needs across all levels of the business. The role includes an Asia regional emphasis. You will facilitate training sessions locally and partner with local learning vendors to design, develop, and implement both global and locally relevant learning programs and courses.
The role requires strategic vision, critical thinking, and innovative approaches to elevate learning programs, strengthen leadership capability, and improve measurable outcomes.**Role Expectations**
The AVP, L\&D:* Has an acute sense of organizational goals and objectives, and designs and delivers learning experiences aligned to business priorities, including priorities across our Asia hubs.
* Has a strong understanding of portfolios and sub\-processes and their learning and development requirements, with the ability to translate global learning strategy into locally effective solutions for India and Philippines audiences.
* Adopts a global One Synchrony mindset in all learning and development initiatives, rooted in strategic thinking, including needs identification, design, delivery, support, vendor partnership, and curation that results in a holistic learning framework with strong adoption and impact in Asia hubs.

**Key Responsibilities*** Develop, design, and deploy Leadership Development programs and programming to ensure employees are equipped with competencies needed to be successful at work, including leadership learning design and facilitation of leadership programs for US and Asia hub audiences.
* Serve as a key learning partner for our Asia hubs by facilitating learning sessions locally (in\-person and virtual) and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality learner experience.
* Partner with local learning vendors in Asia hubs to design, develop, and implement global learning programs (localized as needed) and hub\-specific programs/courses aligned to business and cultural context.
* Implement learning needs identification and assessment tools (surveys, focus groups/brainstorming, one\-to\-one meetings) across hubs.
* Create, maintain and report Learning Dashboards for the L\&D team and function being serviced; effectively measuring impact of all learning interventions by monitoring the success of the programs enabling employees to make the most of learning opportunities and deliver value for the business.
* Create and maintain analytic rigor for learner audience (nominations, footfall, coverage, diversity, impact) with hub\-level tracking globally.
* Measure impact and demonstrable change from learning needs identification through post\-learning outcomes; apply insights to continuously improve learning effectiveness.
* Act as a lead, facilitate programs, and engage as a producer to support program delivery as per learning plans, including end\-to\-end facilitation readiness and delivery excellence.
* Identify and embrace multiple learning modalities (coaching, job\-shadowing, workshops, classroom, online) across in\-person, virtual, and hybrid environments to meet business/individual needs, including time\-zone and learner context considerations for global hubs.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships across all levels of the organization and functions/hubs with consistent stakeholder, Workforce Planning Ops and HR partner engagement, to provide relevant learning opportunities and strengthen adoption and reinforcement in day\-to\-day work.
* Develop and drive stakeholder assessments, learning plans, and projects that assist in facilitation of strategic learning goals.
* Build strong supplier relationships and support the supplier management lifecycle in partnership with the Sourcing and Supplier Management Team, including selection, governance, and performance management to deliver best\-fit content and solutions.
* Stay abreast of developments and challenges in driving a learning culture; bring insights to the L\&D team to develop strategies and focused interventions.
* Budget management, understanding of yearly allocation, proper utilization, and accountability, including budget considerations for Asia hub delivery and vendor partnerships.

**Required Skills/Knowledge*** Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.
* Minimum 2 years of learning, facilitation, instructional design and/or program management experience within/external to Synchrony, including demonstrated experience facilitating leadership programs.
* Demonstrated experience in leadership learning design (e.g., leadership curricula, manager development, cohort\-based experiences, blended solutions).
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills (virtual and in\-person).
* Strategic thinking proficiency, with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable programs and measurable outcomes across global audiences.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities across global stakeholders and different time zones.
* Flexibility in work hours in support of hybrid and global environment.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office applications, including Teams.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge*** Minimum 5\+ years demonstrated learning \& development leadership experience, including leadership program delivery and/or leadership capability building.
* Demonstrated ability to report data and analyze learning processes using reporting tools like Tableau / SAS BI (or similar) to drive improvements and recommendations.
* Ability to think and act strategically in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment; uses critical thinking and innovation to elevate learning outcomes.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with little supervision in a virtual environment, while maintaining strong execution in Asia hubs.
* Strong in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proven facilitation skills and experience delivering presentations and programs at various levels of the organization, including leadership audiences.
* Experience in project management and maintaining budgets.
* Experience in supplier management with strong communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to build strong relationships with supplier partners, including local vendor partnerships in Asia hubs.

**Eligibility criteria**
Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.**Work Timings:**This role is eligible for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally) on most days. This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may vary periodically due to business needs. Given the responsibilities and programs supported, this role will also require some flexibility with work timings. When there is a training program or learning session being conducted, the incumbent would be expected to flex their schedules to be available for the entire duration of the program.
Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.**For Internal Applicants**:* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday.
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format).
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* L8\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible.
* L8 \+ Employees can apply.

title: Compensation & Benefits /Total Rewards Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

  

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

**About you and this role**


As a **Compensation \& Benefits /Total Rewards Specialist** within HR, based in **Mumbai, India** you enable a best\-in\-class employee experience through exceptional service delivery and subject matter consultation. You help manage, implement, and deliver Total Rewards solutions across multiple countries in the EMEAI region.


You bring working knowledge of relevant theories, practices, and procedures, plus general business understanding gained through education and experience. You communicate clearly, ask questions to confirm understanding, and apply established procedures to analyze issues and resolve problems. You are accountable for your assigned contributions (with no direct supervisory responsibility), meet deadlines using standard practices, and continuously look for ways to improve how work gets done.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supports the implementation and delivery of end\-to\-end solutions in Total Rewards to deliver a best\-in\-class employee experience for multiple countries
* Supports program development related to their area(s) of expertise to improve the employee experience, balanced with function\-specific needs and drivers
* Engages with third party providers to establish, develop and review the suite of services in Total Rewards
* Addresses escalated HR inquiries and reviewer/approver of transactions, as applicable.
* Provides information and insights continuously to improve Knowledge Base and Case Management content for Total Rewards


More specifically on the Benefit and Compensation elements **your responsibilities are**

**Benefits**

* To independently manage regional benefits operations and programs to deliver a best\-in\-class employee experience.
* To oversee benefit portals, benchmarking, medical/pension/life/accident insurance programs, and wellbeing initiatives.

**Compensation**

* To manage regional compensation operations and programs to deliver a best\-in\-class employee experience.
* To participate and run remuneration surveys and market benchmarking, present recommendations to stakeholders, and manage the pay\-planning cycle to keep salary ranges competitive.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor or master’s degree in HR, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related area.
* At least 4\+ years of Compensation and Benefits experience, or HR / Finance related experience.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Power Apps

**Preferred Skills**

* Excellent planning \& organization skills
* Strong analytical, innovative and problem\-solving skills
* Works independently, is self\-motivated and accountable
* Fluency in English
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work with a sense of urgency in a highly dynamic environment
* Ability to effectively work through other people and be collaborative with an End\-to\-End mindset.
* Ability to put Dow's success before team and his/her own and able to make decisions that enable Dow to outperform competition
* Ability to support Continuous (digital) process improvement

**Additional Notes**

* We offer workplace flexibility but do require employees to be at least 4 days per week in the office.

**Benefits – What Dow offers you**


We invest in you.

  

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.


Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
	+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
	+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
	+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
	+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
	+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


Join our team, we can make a difference together.

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**


Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.


A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.


As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Staff Talent Acquisition Specialist (Semiconductor)
description:
**Job Description**

  

Job Description


We are seeking a Senior Technical Recruiter with strong semiconductor industry expertise, particularly within Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) environments. The role leads the full end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle while ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers, supported by high standards of data accuracy and process excellence. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical recruiter with deep experience managing complex semiconductor requisitions and operating effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**End\-to\-End Technical Recruitment:**

* Lead the full recruitment cycle from requisition intake to offer acceptance.
* Develop tailored sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill semiconductor roles across design, manufacturing, test, packaging, and operations.

**Sourcing \& Screening:**

* Leverage multiple sourcing channels, semiconductor talent communities, niche platforms, referrals, and proactive market mapping.
* Build longlists and shortlists of qualified semiconductor professionals by applying role\-specific technical filters across semiconductor HW \& SW R\&D IC design, fabrication, equipment engineering, process engineering, test development, and related fields.

**Candidate \& Stakeholder Management:**

* Provide high\-quality CV presentations and candidate summaries to hiring managers.
* Advise hiring teams on market conditions, candidate availability, competitive intelligence, and recruitment timelines.
* Ensure consistent communication and outstanding experiences for candidates throughout the process.

**Operation \& System Excellence:**

* Manage all recruitment status updates in ATS, ensuring transparency and accuracy.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional teams including HRBPs, HR Operations, and Business Leaders for compliance and smooth Process flows.

**Industry Expertise:**

* Demonstrate strong familiarity with semiconductor roles across the IDM value chain, including:
* R\&D, SoC Architect, Performance Modelling, Chip Lead, RTL Design, Design Verification, Physical Design, STA, DFT, Validation,
* Process integration, yield engineering
* Manufacturing, Packaging, Testing
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of global semiconductor talent markets, competitive landscapes, and emerging skill trends.

 **Qualifications**

  

Qualifications

* 10\+ years of technical recruiting experience, with at least 5 years in semiconductor talent acquisition.
* Proven success in recruiting for niche semiconductor technical roles.
* Strong analytical and research skills for sourcing and talent mapping.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic, global business environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment workflow management.

 **Company Description**

  

Company Description


Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.


Renesas employees roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world

 **Additional Information**

  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.  

  

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  

  

At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.


Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?


Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our **Diversity \& Inclusion Statement**.


We have adopted a hybrid model that gives employees the ability to work remotely two days a week while ensuring that we come together as a team in the office the rest of the time. The designated in\-office days are Tuesday through Thursday for innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

title: Human Resource Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Job Profile:** Talent Business Advisor Senior Associate

**Location:** Hyderabad/ Noida India

  

Responsibilities:

* Support Talent Business Leaders and Advisors in the execution of core talent processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, performance management, rewards processes, and employee engagement initiatives), leveraging core Talent systems (e.g., Workday, Betterworks, etc.) and the data they generate.
* Serve as the point of coordination for operational tasks such as Leaves of Absence (LOA), Flexible Work Arrangements (FWA), and relocations, working closely with relevant Talent Solutions and business leaders to ensure timely and accurate execution.
* Act as a resource to employees and leaders by addressing routine talent\-related inquiries and escalating complex matters as appropriate.
* Collect, maintain, and prepare data and reports for review by the Talent Business Advisory and BU Operations teams.
* Assist in identifying data trends or inconsistencies and formulating these observations into insights that may inform talent decisions or process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with HR policies and procedures in all actions and communications, , using data\-driven approaches.
* Help drive awareness and understanding of talent programs through employee education and communication support.
* Contribute to the implementation of firmwide and business\-unit\-specific talent programs by coordinating logistics, managing communications, and supporting the day\-to\-day project activities.
* Work with others across Talent Solutions and the broader Talent function to ensure consistency and alignment in talent\-related services and processes.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

description:
**Company Description**  

Oetiker provides customers with the peace of mind that their mission\-critical components are reliably connected. We are a global leader in high\-end connecting solutions for the vehicle industry and for high\-value applications in industrial segments. Our expertise in high\-quality clamps, rings, straps and quick\-connectors ranges from powertrain and drivetrain applications to medical applications. We offer engineering, prototyping and testing support to quickly create comprehensive solutions for overcoming clamping and connecting challenges. With 1800\+ employees in more than 30 countries and over 75 years of experience, we are the trusted, global, long\-term partner for the world’s leading OEMs.

 **Job Description** **Talent Acquisition Specialist Oetiker Group**


As a Talent Acquisition Specialist at Oetiker Group, you will be instrumental in enhancing our global recruitment strategies, optimizing technological tools, and advancing our vacancy reporting and talent acquisition processes. This role demands a proactive approach to managing global recruitment requirements, with a particular focus on acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for challenging and unique roles. You will play a crucial part in transitioning our practices from regional to global standards, ensuring consistency and excellence across all talent acquisition standards and practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

title: Associate Director - Talent Acquisition New
description:
### **About Zinnov**



Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high\-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:


* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M\&A decisions, and long\-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data\-led, execution\-focused, and outcome\-driven** — not opinion\-heavy slideware.



At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450\+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER\&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media \& Telecom, and Private Equity.



Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Why Globalisation Excellence**



Zinnov’s Globalisation Excellence (GE) practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end\-to\-end — from Design \& Discovery to Build, Scale, and Run.



In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:


* Own complex, end\-to\-end client journeys
* Work across GCC advisory, managed services, and BOT / outsourcing models
* Influence leadership decisions that shape long\-term talent and operating strategies


This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.


**About the Role**



As **Associate** **Director – Talent Acquisition**, you will lead the hiring strategy and execution for a Global Capability Center (GCC) client in Hyderabad. You will own end\-to\-end recruitment across **Technology, Engineering, and Corporate/Functional roles**, partnering closely with senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.



This role is designed for a data\-driven TA leader who can scale hiring in a fast\-paced environment, build strong pipelines for niche roles, run predictable operating rhythms, and drive high\-quality outcomes through strong team leadership, stakeholder alignment, and process excellence.


**What You’ll Do**


**TA Strategy \& Workforce Planning**


* Own the end\-to\-end TA strategy across Technology, Engineering, and Functional hiring for the GCC.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with business leaders and HRBPs — demand forecasting, prioritization, and execution plans.
* Build scalable hiring playbooks to support growth across multiple role families and seniority levels.


**Niche Hiring \& Pipeline Building**


* Build robust talent pipelines for niche and hard\-to\-hire roles through proactive sourcing beyond portals.
* Strengthen channel strategy across referrals, sourcing teams, vendors, research\-based mapping, and talent communities.
* Drive hiring outcomes across critical roles with speed, quality, and consistency.


**Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership**


* Partner closely with senior leadership (Global / India) to understand business needs and translate them into hiring plans.
* Run structured business reviews, share market intelligence, and align on hiring trade\-offs and feasibility.
* Maintain high stakeholder confidence through clarity, cadence, and transparent progress updates.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**


* Lead, mentor, and scale a high\-performing TA team across recruiters, sourcers, and TA ops.
* Drive capability building on sourcing, assessment quality, role selling, tools, and candidate experience.
* Implement best practices for productivity, bandwidth allocation, and performance management.


**Process Excellence \& Candidate Experience**


* Own and optimize recruitment processes to improve turnaround time, quality of hires, and candidate experience.
* Ensure smooth coordination across sourcing, recruitment operations, onboarding, and HR teams.
* Drive offer management and conversion — engagement, negotiation, and offer\-to\-join closure discipline.


**Metrics, Reporting \& TA Dashboards**


* Build and run TA dashboards covering TAT, pipeline health, conversion ratios, offer\-to\-join, hiring forecasts, and recruiter productivity.
* Establish KPI discipline across TA teams and drive action plans based on insights.
* Present hiring trends, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership with decision\-ready narratives.


**Technology, Tools \& Continuous Improvement**


* Leverage ATS and HR tools (e.g., Greenhouse / Workday / SuccessFactors or similar) to improve hiring efficiency.
* Advocate for automation, AI tools, and process upgrades that enhance speed and quality.
* Improve data hygiene and operational rigor to ensure reliable reporting and forecasting.


**Employer Branding \& Recruitment Marketing**


* Partner with branding/communications teams to strengthen the GCC’s employer value proposition.
* Drive recruitment marketing initiatives for tech, engineering, and functional talent segments.
* Build visibility and attractiveness in talent markets through targeted campaigns and community engagement.


**What You Bring**


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* 15\+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with **5\+ years in a leadership role**.
* Strong expertise hiring across **Tech, Engineering, and Corporate/Functional** roles.
* Experience scaling hiring in a fast\-paced, stakeholder\-heavy environment (GCC / product / engineering preferred).
* Strong comfort with recruitment analytics, TA operations, and forecasting.


**Key Skills**


* TA strategy, workforce planning, and end\-to\-end hiring ownership.
* Advanced stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Strong people leadership — coaching, performance management, team scaling.
* Data\-driven execution — dashboards, funnel management, conversion optimization.
* Process rigor — structured operating rhythm, predictable delivery, high\-quality candidate experience.
* Strong sourcing and pipeline strategy for niche roles and competitive talent markets.


**What Success Looks Like**


* TA strategy translated into predictable outcomes across technology, engineering, and functional hiring.
* Healthy pipelines for niche roles, with strong funnel visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
* Improved conversion metrics — higher offer\-to\-join, faster closures, stronger candidate engagement.
* High stakeholder confidence driven by clarity, cadence, and decision\-ready reporting.
* A high\-performing TA team with strong execution standards, capability depth, and scalable operating rhythms.


**If you enjoy owning high\-scale GCC hiring end\-to\-end, influencing senior stakeholders through data and market insight, and building a high\-performing TA engine that delivers speed and quality — this role offers both impact and growth.**

**Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

title: Analyst – Financial Reporting & Analytics
description:
**Your Job**
As an **Analyst \- Reporting \& Analytics**, you will support the **Molex Central Finance** function. This is a **key role** responsible for supporting the implementation, stabilization, and ongoing management of the **Central Finance system at Molex** . You will play a critical role in ensuring **financial data quality, completeness, and integrity** between legacy ERP systems and Central Finance. The role requires close ownership of **financial reconciliations/tie\-outs** and error monitoring, ensuring transactional consistency between legacy systems and Central Finance, and supporting period close activities. In addition, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining **standardized financial reporting packages** for multiple stakeholder groups.

**Our Team**


You will be part of the **Global** **Central Finance** team, a group that partners closely with Finance leaders, Reporting leaders, Master data, and ERP leaders.


**What You Will Do**


* Support **Central Finance reporting and analytics activities** by working closely with the implementation partner and workstream leaders
* Perform **data tie\-outs and reconciliations** between **Central Finance, OneStream, SAP, and other source systems** to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Build working knowledge of **core financial statements** including **Trial Balance, Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and US GAAP reports** as part of training and on\-the\-job learning.
* Monitor **Application Interface Framework (AIF)** jobs to identify data load errors and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
* Execute **consolidated and unconsolidated data reconciliations** between OneStream/SAP and Central Finance.
* Escalate data issues, variances, and process gaps to workstream leaders with clear documentation and observations.
* Participate in **daily and weekly working calls**, providing status updates on assigned activities and raising risks as needed.
* Identify opportunities to **automate or streamline recurring tasks** under guidance from the team.
* Deliver assigned responsibilities in line with **defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards**.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**


* , with **2\-6 years of experience** in **Record\-to\-Report (R2R), financial reporting, planning, analysis, or consolidation**; **freshers** with a strong understanding of company financials will also be considered.
* Exposure to **financial and operational reporting**, including **GAAP reports, tax reports, costing reports, Profit \& Loss, and Balance Sheet analysis**.
* Working knowledge of **SAP General Ledger structure** and experience creating and posting **journal entries**.
* Basic understanding of **ERP backend data structures**, database files, and reporting/support tools.
* Ability to apply structured approaches to **analyze financial data and support reporting issue resolution**.
* Strong **communication and interpersonal skills**, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to **execute tasks independently**, while also working effectively in a team\-based environment.

**What Will Put You Ahead**


* Exposure to working with **cross\-functional stakeholders** across Finance, Operations, and Business teams.
* Understanding of **core financial concepts**, including **P\&L, costing, and statutory vs. management/consolidated reporting** **and US GAAP**
* , a proactive mindset, and a willingness to learn and take initiative.

title: Asset & Wealth Management - Ayco WSS - Analyst - Bengaluru
description:
**About Goldman Sachs**



At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.


**YOUR IMPACT**



Are you a quick\-thinking self\-starter with a passion for the financial markets, have the desire to work closely with high net worth individuals and the ability to think outside the box? Our client service professionals provide proactive financial counseling, full\-service implementation, including tax preparation and investments, to address complexities of executives, entrepreneurs and high net worth individuals. We are seeking professionals with an understanding of the markets who have the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where attention to detail, strong communication skills, and client service are essential to maintaining and enhancing our business.


**OUR IMPACT**


**Wealth Management**



Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor\-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra\-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our consumer business provides digital solutions for customers to better spend, borrow, invest, and save. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading\-edge technology, data and design.


**Goldman Sachs Ayco**



Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) partners with Fortune 1000 companies to design and implement tailored financial planning programs for their workforce and leveraging the 50\-year heritage of Ayco and the comprehensive resources of Goldman Sachs to meet the evolving needs of their employees. Ayco believes companies best serve their stakeholders and the greater economy when their employees financial lives are clear, understood and in their control. Ayco advisors and technical specialists help clients achieve their personal financial goals through education and guided implementation across seven key financial disciplines, including employee benefit planning.


**JOB SUMMARY AND RESPONSBILITIES**


* Serving as the primary operational driver of the Executive Wealth (EW) team by triaging incoming inquiries and tracking client priorities:
* Asist Advisor teams, who work one\-on\-one with individual and/or corporate clients providing comprehensive personal financial planning, investment planning and tax services to corporate employees, executives and other high\-net\-worth individuals
* Work closely with Wealth Advisor teams to support their AYCO clients
* Leverage your operational background and experience to contribute to a growing business
* Proactively anticipate, determine and recommend solutions to meet client needs and/or resolve issues surrounding investment related transactions
* Manage cash balances and private banking services in accounts
* Resolve time sensitive client service\-related issues, including complex situations
* Plan and manage new account onboarding process, asset transfers and other account service requests
* Managing the pipeline of new business opportunities in Salesforce
* Prepare various reports for clients in the areas of cash flow planning, income tax projections, investment allocation, investment performance, estate flowcharts, etc.
* Facilitate various aspects of client portfolio performance reporting and analysis
* Assist with tax activities, including tax return quality control, estimated payments, e\-filing
* Interface with internal groups to complete various investment and operational tasks.
* Complete positive/negative consent client emails, handle exception tracking and comments.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


* CA fresher Jan'26 cleared
* Proficiency in Microsoft products such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality
* Enthusiastic and positive approach to problem\-solving and client service
* Proven track record with cross\-training, task\-sharing and mutually supportive teamwork
* Must be able to be innovative, pro\-actively manage time and follow through to complete tasks
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment

title: Corporate Consulting Analyst
description:
We are seeking an India\-based legally qualified professionals (Legal Executives / Corporate Consultant/ Law Graduates / Qualified Lawyers) to support our UK\-qualified solicitors in delivering high\-quality, compliant, and efficient legal services. This role will be strictly limited to unreserved legal activities. All work will be supervised by a UK\-qualified Solicitor. The legal executive must adhere to the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) regulatory boundaries and comply with strict confidentiality and data\-handling protocols.

* Role Purpose

The legal executive will provide high\-quality support to UK\-qualified solicitors. The role is focused strictly on unreserved legal activities, performed under direct supervision of UK\-qualified solicitors, in accordance with Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) rules. The legal executive will assist with document handling, client communication, drafting, research, case progression, and operational support relating to CICA matters.

***The role requires strong analytical skills, excellent written communication, high attention to detail, and a disciplined approach to confidentiality and data protection.***

* Key Responsibilities (Unreserved Activities Only)

The legal executive will perform only unreserved tasks, including but not limited to:

* Case Support and Administration
* Assist with day\-to\-day management of CICA claim files.
* Maintain case records, track deadlines, and ensure accuracy of file documentation.
* Support evidence gathering, including obtaining client information, medical records, police reports, and related documents.
* Drafting and Document Preparation
* Draft unreserved correspondence, statements, summaries, chronologies, and research memos for review by a supervising UK solicitor.
* Prepare initial drafts of CICA claim forms, schedules, and supporting submissions (subject to UK solicitor approval).
* Conduct document review and organise evidence bundles.
* Client Liaison (Within Defined Scope)
* Communicate with clients regarding factual updates and requests for information.
* Manage routine follow\-ups with clients to obtain documentation or clarify factual details.
* Ensure all client communications are properly documented and escalated to supervising solicitors where necessary.
* Legal Research and Analysis
* Perform research relating to CICA Scheme provisions, guidance materials, and procedural updates.
* Summarize key findings for supervising UK solicitors to support case strategy.
* Operational and Compliance Support
* Adhere to internal policies on confidentiality, GDPR, IT security, and secure handling of sensitive personal data.
* Maintain accurate time recording and workflow documentation as required.
* Ensure that all tasks remain strictly within the scope of unreserved legal work and escalate any borderline matters immediately.
* Prohibited (Reserved) Activities

In compliance with SRA regulatory requirements, the legal executive must not, under any circumstances:

* Provide reserved legal advice or independent legal opinions.
* Exercise rights of audience or conduct litigation.
* Issue proceedings, file formal court documents, or communicate with tribunals as a representative.
* Engage in conduct reserved to authorised persons under the Legal Services Act 2007\.
* Hold themselves out as a UK solicitor or authorised person.
* Make strategic or settlement decisions without instruction from a supervising UK solicitor.

All work must remain firmly within the unreserved scope and be subject to UK solicitor oversight.

* Required Skills and Competencies
* Strong understanding of legal processes, particularly personal injury or compensation\-based claims (experience with CICA preferred).
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.**
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fully remote environment.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information securely.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation capabilities.
* Proficiency with MS Office, document\-management tools, and secure IT practices.
* Qualifications and Experience
* Law degree (LLB or equivalent) from a recognised institution in India.
* **Prior experience working as a legal executive or legal analyst supporting UK, US, or common\-law jurisdictions is preferred.**
* **Experience in personal injury, compensation claims, or investigative legal work is an advantage.**
* Familiarity with the CICA Scheme is desirable but not essential; training will be provided.
* Reporting and Supervision Framework
* The legal executive will be fully supervised by an assigned UK\-qualified solicitor.
* All work outputs must be reviewed, approved, and directed by a UK solicitor before external use.
* The legal executive must participate in scheduled supervision calls, workflow reviews, and QA processes.
* Escalation protocols must be followed for any issue involving legal judgement, case strategy, compliance risk, or reserved\-activity boundaries.
* Data Protection and Information Security

Given the sensitive nature of CICA work, the following standards must be strictly adhered to:

* Compliance with UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, and internal data\-security protocols.
* Use of approved secure systems for document storage, communication, and case handling.
* Prohibition on use of personal devices or unsecure networks for work\-related activities.
* Mandatory training in confidentiality, cyber\-security, and information\-handling practices.
* Working Arrangements
* Remote working arrangement from India via employer Reighway.
* Standard working hours aligned to UK business hours, unless otherwise agreed.
* Participation in virtual team meetings, supervision sessions, and ongoing professional development.
* Occasional flexibility may be required to align with UK case deadlines or client needs.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Accuracy and quality of drafted documents.
* Compliance with SRA\-aligned processes and regulatory boundaries.
* Timeliness in completing assigned tasks.
* Responsiveness and reliability in supervised workflows.
* Adherence to confidentiality, GDPR, and internal information\-security standards.
* Positive feedback from supervising UK solicitors.

**Important Note:** *Candidates are expected to attend the interview having prepared an overview and working understanding of CICA claims and procedures, together with an awareness of the relevant regulatory requirements of the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)*
